The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through re-seller(s)} should have supplied same or similar Catego ry Products for 20% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU. Copies of relevant contracts (copies of CRAC/CRN/IC e tc) proving supply of cumulative order quantity in any one financial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant Financial year. 9. Bank Guarantee format for submission of ePBG @5% enclosed. 10. At least one sample will be extracted from between 30% to 70% of the offered length from a randomly selected drum, and subjected to all acceptance tests as per clause 16.2 of IS 7098 part 1: 2025 or latest. 11. Measurement of conductor resistance will be done on the complete lot and on the complete offered dr um/coil length. 12. Rewinding of sample drums will be done during pre-dispatch inspection to strictly verify length as per t he IS code sampling plan. 13. After receipt of Material, Railway may select the sample from the supplied material for testing from Go vernment laboratory. If sample fails, material will be rejected and necessary action will be taken as per ex tent policy/rules. 14. Verification of sequential meter markings will be done during inspection using calibrated tapes and che cking for physical homogeneity of size and shape throughout the cable length. . 10.
